claims.text: The source defines Flow Matching: CNF vector field trained simulation-free by regressing conditional (per-sample) vector fields (CFM, equal gradients per Thm 2); Gaussian conditional paths N(mu_t, sigma_t^2 I) with optimal-transport variant mu=t·x1 giving straight trajectories; same ADM UNet backbone across losses for ablation.
Reported numbers: CIFAR-10 FM-OT NLL 2.99, FID 6.35, NFE 142 vs DDPM 3.12/7.48/274; ImageNet-64 NLL 3.31/FID 14.45/NFE 138; ImageNet-128 NLL 2.90/FID 20.9; training cost constant.

limitations.text: CIFAR FID higher than tuned literature (backbone not CIFAR-optimised); adaptive-solver NFE still 100+; marginal field not OT-optimal despite conditional OT.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Trajectory-straightness vs rectified-flow reflow and high-res text-conditional transfer not established.
